text: {"rules":[{"id":"OSTEO-SCREEN-PM-LT65","version":"January 2025","title":"Osteoporosis screening: postmenopausal women younger than 65 years at increased fracture risk","source_quote":"The USPSTF recommends screening for osteoporosis to prevent osteoporotic fractures in postmenopausal women younger than 65 years who are at increased risk for an osteoporotic fracture as estimated by clinical risk assessment.","grade":"B","effective_date":"2025-01","action":"Screen for osteoporosis to prevent osteoporotic fractures","denominator":"{\"all\":[{\"sex\":{\"is\":\"F\"},\"quote\":\"women\"},{\"age\":{\"max\":64,\"at\":\"end\"},\"quote\":\"younger than 65 years\",\"derived\":{\"max\":\"'younger than 65 years' in whole years means age 64 or less at end of measurement year\"}},{\"uncomputable\":{\"needs\":\"postmenopausal status\"},\"quote\":\"postmenopausal women\"},{\"uncomputable\":{\"needs\":\"clinical risk assessment showing increased osteoporotic fracture risk (clinician judgment / risk tool)\"},\"quote\":\"at increased risk for an osteoporotic fracture as estimated by clinical risk assessment\"}],\"quote\":\"postmenopausal women younger than 65 years\"}","numerator":"{\"uncomputable\":{\"needs\":\"osteoporosis screening test type and screening interval, neither stated in this section (deferred to Practice Considerations)\"},\"quote\":\"screening for osteoporosis\",\"note\":\"Likely dxa_scan, but test modality and look-back window are not specified in the section text, so not encoded as computable\"}","exclusions":"[]"}],"coverage_notes":["No minimum age is stated; none was added. Population is bounded only by 'postmenopausal' (uncomputable) and 'younger than 65 years'.","Postmenopausal status is not reliably held in structured EHR data and is encoded as uncomputable.","Increased fracture risk 'as estimated by clinical risk assessment' depends on risk factors/risk tools and clinician judgment that this section does not specify; encoded as uncomputable rather than approximated.","Screening test type (e.g., DXA, concept dxa_scan) and screening interval/rescreening frequency are deferred to the 'Practice Considerations' section, which is not included here; numerator left uncomputable instead of inventing a window.","Treatment or follow-up after an abnormal screen is not described in this section and is not represented.","The DATE field has an unexplained asterisk ('January 2025 *'); its meaning is not given in this section."]}
